text: thats the problem is that im not merging faces to begin with. no wonder its not finding it. you have to delete the two triangles and then create a face between two edges in the space
resolution: User clarified their quad workflow is delete-two-tris + create-face, not Merge Faces, and rejected keep+X (cuts whole part, ignores deliberate asymmetry, unwelded seam). Measured the twin spaces: mostly offset import quads, so per-quad matching can't scale. Built the faithful generalization: meshMirrorReplaceSelection — selection-scoped mirror stamp that deletes whole twin faces buried in the stamped space, re-creates the selection reflected (quads stay quads), and welds seam (1mm plane sharing) + borders (position-class snap to survivors). copy sel chip in the symmetry strip + seat mirror-replace + stats-bearing receipts. Commit 32001a9e1; needs dev-host rebuild.
